items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Dan Toby, Fred Solomon, Eddie Anderson, Clifton Bennett, and scores of others...

ctx.x: I think you dropped a line there.
Yeah. " Martha and Cliff Ritchie, Harvey Brooks, Pinkie Tomlin, Baby Mack, Dan Toby, Fred Solomon, Eddie Anderson, Clifton Bennett, and scores of others, including movie stars and directors.

" Mr. Curtis Moseby and Herman Hill came in for applause. After presenting one of the most pretentious floor reviews currently in the West. Patsy Hunter, the producer, was paid a remarkable tribute for her well-received efforts. The floor review was wisely presented, in that it does not attempt to place any individual star, but rather presents a well-balanced bill that spells a good show.
